user.title: SB Notify
user.description: One door for phone notifications: an Alerts group for problems and a Notifications group for household notices.

data.head_card: Status card at the top of the Alerts group
data.dismiss_return_hours: Dismissed alerts still open come back after

data_description.notify_service: A mobile_app notify service, e.g. notify.mobile_app_pixel_snadboy
data_description.dismiss_return_hours: 0 = a dismissed alert stays off the phone until it gets worse

raise.name: Raise alert
raise.description: Open a problem, or refresh it if it is already open. Notifies once; notifies again only if the severity goes up.

key.name: Key
key.description: Stable id for this problem, e.g. pkdb:task:tier2_backfill.

title.name: Title
title.description: One line, shown on the phone.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: critical rings and repeats until dismissed; warning is silent and repeats once; info never pushes.

url.name: URL
url.description: Where a tap on the card goes.

source.name: Source
source.description: Which system raised it, e.g. pkdb.

ttl.name: TTL
ttl.description: Resolve automatically if not raised again within this time.

channel.name: Phone channel
channel.description: Use this Android notification channel instead of the severity's own, e.g. alarm for power outages.

escalate.name: Escalate
escalate.description: This update is worse even at the same severity (an outage spreading): ring again and bring the card back if it was dismissed.

resolve.name: Resolve alert
resolve.description: Mark a problem fixed. Its card becomes a short 'Resolved' card that clears itself.

key.name: Key
key.description: The key it was raised with.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Show a household notice in the Notifications group, replacing any notice with the same key.

title.name: Title
title.description: One line, shown on the phone.

url.name: URL
url.description: Where a tap on the card goes.

ttl.name: TTL
ttl.description: Clear it after this long (default 4 hours; 0 keeps it until cleared).

clear.name: Clear notice
clear.description: Remove a notice from the phone.

key.name: Key
key.description: The key it was shown with.

dismiss.name: Dismiss alert
dismiss.description: Take an alert off the phone and stop reminders. It stays open until resolved, comes back once after the set time if still open, and at once if it gets worse.

key.name: Key
key.description: The key it was raised with.
